connector.name: FOTOhub Creative AI
connector.registryDescription: Generate images, video, music, voice and 3D through one API. 30 tools, 200+ models.
connector.summary: Hosted at apis.fotohub.app over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.fotohub, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: a FOTOhub API key from fotohub.app/console, e.g. 'Bearer fh_live_...'
